social.author: Dana Whitfield
social.text: Team Pillbert has dropped quarterback Geno Smith, who put up 18 points in his one week of work. Alan's QB plans for the week ahead are worth watching.

social.author: Bayou Brian
social.text: Philly cutting a quarterback who just gave him 18 points is a bold way to start a Tuesday. Hope there's a plan, because I can't see it.

social.author: Habibster Nation
social.text: Geno Smith is out on the wire and Alan is the one who put him there. Habib is being handed a head start in this matchup and we'll take it.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Habibsters sit at 43% against Team Pillbert, so a quarterback shuffle on Alan's side matters. Dropping 18 points of production is a risk I'd want explained.

social.author: Dana Whitfield
social.text: The fumblers picked up two running backs off waivers, Tony Pollard and Jonah Coleman. Derrick Henry is already on the roster, so this looks like depth, and it's worth noting Randy rarely makes moves at all.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Ghostu-Spider SZN is at 38% against No Banner only HULK, and swapping in the Broncos D/ST and a new kicker is the kind of small edge Zoe needs. Smart use of the free agent pool.

social.author: Sal Benedetto
social.text: Sonny cut Marvin Harrison Jr. for the Buccaneers D/ST and I LOVE it. Defense wins weeks, mark it down, LOCK.

social.author: Habibster Nation
social.text: Keenan Allen is a Habibster and Chris Boswell is gone. Habib is out here shuffling the deck before kickoff against Philly, and honestly we need it.

social.author: Dana Whitfield
social.text: Sonny made a run of moves on his defense and tight end spots: Texans D/ST in, Bengals D/ST out, then Buccaneers D/ST cut loose. Mike Gesicki also replaces Hunter Henry, who had 15.1 points over four weeks.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: The Horse is Hea is at 74% against Counting or not Counting GV, so I get the tinkering. Still, swapping out Hunter Henry for Mike Gesicki on the strength of a one-week sample is the kind of move I'd want a reason for.

social.author: Sal Benedetto
social.text: Texans D/ST for Sonny is a LOCK, and I will not be taking questions about the Bengals. They know what they did.

social.author: Cheddar Curtis
social.text: Sonny dropped three roster spots' worth of stuff in one sitting and added DeMario Douglas. Is the commish just clicking everything on the waiver page?

social.author: Dana Whitfield
social.text: Team Pillbert added Tyler Allgeier off the free agent list. He's a running back with nothing on the board in his one week of production, so this reads as depth for Alan, not a statement.

social.author: Habibster Nation
social.text: Philly picking up Tyler Allgeier with a lineup already stacked at running back. Either he knows something or he just likes clicking the add button.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Habibsters are at 41% against Team Pillbert. Allgeier hasn't produced anything yet, so I wouldn't read much into this add unless Alan is planning a swap.

social.author: Jordan's Section
social.text: Bhayshul Tuten punches it in for Counting or not Counting GV and JMoney is up on Sonny before most of his lineup has even kicked off. I'll take it.

social.author: Habibster Nation
social.text: Jaguars D/ST just handed Habib ten points before Philly has even touched the board. First time all season the luck has gone our way, don't jinx it.

social.author: Sal Benedetto
social.text: Jaguars D/ST for Habibsters is exactly what I said, LOCK. Alan is down ten and hasn't played a snap, and I'm not taking questions.

social.author: Counting or not Counting GV
social.text: Touchdown, Bhayshul Tuten! He finds the end zone and we jump out to an early lead on The Horse is Hea.

social.author: Horse Hea Heads
social.text: Parker Washington finds the end zone and Sonny takes the lead right back. Jordan had about four minutes of being happy.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: The Horse is Hea is up to 83% now that Parker Washington has the lead flipped. The fumblers are still only at 23% against Dawgs despite Trevor Lawrence's touchdown, because Mekhi hasn't started a single player yet.

social.author: Windy City Fumble
social.text: Trevor Lawrence throws a touchdown and Randy is up sixteen on Mekhi before Ja'Marr Chase has even played. I refuse to be comfortable about this.

social.author: The fumblers
social.text: Trevor Lawrence hits paydirt through the air and we're out in front early. Nice start in Jacksonville.

social.author: Horse Hea Heads
social.text: Sonny just grabbed Patrick Mahomes off the wire and cut Mike Gesicki loose. Mahomes still has to play tonight, so the commish went and picked up a whole quarterback for free. Great Thursday.

social.author: Sal Benedetto
social.text: Mahomes on Sonny's roster is a LOCK to go off tonight. Yes I know he's still got a game to play. Screenshot this, I'll never delete it.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Sonny is already at 84% against Jordan, so Mahomes is a luxury add, not a rescue. Gesicki had no points all season, so the cost of the swap is basically zero.

social.author: The Horse is Hea
social.text: Welcome to the stable, Patrick Mahomes. The QB joins the lineup and Mike Gesicki heads back to the free agent pool.

social.author: Windy City Fumble
social.text: Randy dropped Tre Tucker and picked up Rome Odunze, and I've watched this man refuse to trade for two years. Now he's out here moving Bears fans' hearts around on the wire. I'm going to need a minute.

social.author: Dana Whitfield
social.text: Randy swaps Tre Tucker for Rome Odunze off waivers. Odunze has had the better recent stretch by a good margin, and he's a straight upgrade for The fumblers' receiver room.

social.author: Dawgs Kennel
social.text: Randy cutting Tre Tucker after two decent weeks and grabbing Odunze is a lot of effort for a guy who's already up nineteen on us with nobody of ours played yet. Kai, please start playing.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Odunze for Tucker is the right call on pure scoring. Luffy still has The fumblers at only 10% against Dawgs, because Mekhi has a full lineup left to play and Randy has most of his roster still to go.

social.author: Dawgs Kennel
social.text: The Falcons defense just gave Kai ten points before most of his lineup has even kicked off. That's the kind of start we needed, and the gap is already down to nine.

social.author: Windy City Fumble
social.text: Falcons D/ST puts up ten for Mekhi and my cushion is suddenly just over nine. Randy's got Tee Higgins and a bunch of guys who haven't played, so I'm not exhaling yet.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: The Falcons defense is a real swing for Dawgs, but Luffy still has The fumblers at 6% for a reason. Mekhi has Chase live and a deep lineup to go, and he's still trailing by roughly nine.

social.author: Dawgs
social.text: Falcons D/ST comes up big and puts ten on the board for us. Plenty of football left, Dawgs.

social.author: Dawgs Kennel
social.text: Chase just walked into the end zone and Kai's got the lead. Four hundredths of a point, and I'm already refreshing the app like it owes me money.

social.author: Windy City Fumble
social.text: Tee Higgins is sitting on zero, Chase scores, and we're behind by four hundredths of a point. Randy has a whole second wave of players to play, but I'm going to be sick anyway.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Burrow's touchdown pass gives Jordan the lead, but Luffy still has The Horse is Hea at 90% because Sonny has Smith-Njigba, Mahomes and a lot of roster still to play.

social.author: Horse Stable Hank
social.text: Burrow throws a touchdown for Jordan and we're down three. Fine, whatever. Sonny has eight guys left, I'm choosing to be calm.

social.author: Web Slinger Weekly
social.text: Bijan punches it in and Zoe is up twenty-one before Saquon or Nico have even kicked off. Not a bad way to start a rookie season Sunday.

social.author: Ghostu-Spider SZN
social.text: Bijan Robinson finds the end zone and we're on the board with a big lead. Plenty more to come from this lineup, Spider fam.

social.author: Dr. Nina Kessler
social.text: Bijan's touchdown puts Zoe up twenty-one to nothing, but Luffy still has her at only 35% against No Banner only HULK. Brucie has McCaffrey, Allen, Walker and Kelce all yet to play, so that lead is less comfortable than it looks.
